Here's what I found for Order #3155 (Arrived Late, $74.00):

There's no option that gives you the **full $74 back in real money while also letting you keep the item** — that combination isn't offered. Here's the breakdown:

| Option | Money type | Amount | Keep item? |
|---|---|---|---|
| Return + Refund | Real money | $74.00 | ❌ No — must return the item |
| Keep Item + Shipping Refund | Real money | $12.00 | ✅ Yes |
| Keep Item + Store Credit | Voucher/credit | $20.00 | ✅ Yes |

Since you said you want **actual money back** (not a voucher) *and* are happy to keep the item, the only match is **Keep Item + Shipping Refund** — $12.00 refunded to your original payment method, processed immediately, no return needed.

The store credit option is worth more ($20) but that's a voucher, which you said you don't want. The full $74 refund is only available if you return the item.

Want me to select **Keep Item + Shipping Refund**? Nothing will be finalized until you approve it yourself.
